messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> P0: GPU memory pressure detected in us-west2a (service=infer-production). Incident PD#123456 fired. Auto-remediation allowed.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD#123456 • https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD123456 • triggered by metric: gpu_mem_used_pct>95% on infer-rt-3

Sasha: Ack. I'm on it, heading to logs and metrics.

Arjun: Quick triage: multiple cudaMalloc failures and OOMs on infer-rt-3. Sample from node log:```
[2026-03-17T12:07:11Z] cudaMalloc 0x7f8d3e00 failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T12:07:11Z] TensorAllocator::alloc() size=2.1GB pool=GPU0
[2026-03-17T12:07:12Z] evicting KV cache entry 0x3f2a...````

Maria: CS pinged — some customers seeing increased 500s for embeddings and chat timeouts for ~2-3 minutes. No major outage yet but error rate spike ~4x on a subset of hosts.

Ops Lead: Status check: traffic 98% routing fine, tail latency +250ms for a small slice. Auto-evac of infer-rt-3 is allowed (policy: evacuate-on-gpu-oom). Plan: 1) trigger node evac, 2) scale hot pool +2, 3) enable quantized fallback for embeddings route for 10m.

Sasha: Initiating evac now -> `/infra evict-node infer-rt-3 --reason gpu-oom --dry-run=false`

Arjun: Running scale and route changes:```bash
# scale hot pool
redwoodctl pools scale --pool infer-west2a-hot --delta 2
# enable fallback
redwoodctl routes update --route embeddings --fallback small-quant --ttl 10m
```

Sasha: Evac done. Node infer-rt-3 cordoned and workloads drained (approx 240 active sessions rerouted).

pagerduty-bot: PD#123456 acknowledged by Sasha. Auto-escalation suppressed.

Ops Lead: Can someone confirm customer error rate and latency after reroute?

Maria: Post-reroute metrics: error rate back to baseline within ~90s, overall 95th latency reduced to pre-incident levels. CS notified.

Arjun: Logs show no further cudaMalloc failures on the remaining pool. We'll keep quantized fallback for 10m as planned.

Sasha: Taking lead for mitigation notes, handing incident to Maria for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. @Maria please own action items.

Maria: On it — I will open the incident ticket, capture timeline, and propose a mitigation to prevent KV cache growth causing OOM (possible short-term: cap per-request KV cache size). ETA for postmortem draft: 1 hour.

Oncall Next: I'll monitor metrics for the next 2 hours and escalate if we see any regressions.

incident-bot: Auto-remediation summary: node-evac(infer-rt-3)=success, pool-scale(infer-west2a-hot)+2=success, route-fallback(embeddings)=enabled (10m TTL).

Sasha: Closing active mitigation. Leaving incident open for PMF/pm. Thanks team :thumbsup:
